subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Volume and Capacity

outcomes.text: determine the volume and capacity of cones and pyramids,
compute volume and capacity of a frustum of a cone,
calculate the volume and capacity of a frustum of a pyramid,
apply volume and capacity of in real-life situations,
appreciate volumes and capacities in real life situations.

content: Application of volumes of pyramids and frustums.
inquiry_questions: Why is the knowledge of volume and capacity useful?
coreCompetencies:
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: the learner acquires open-mindedness and creativity skills when discussing with peers and working out the volume and capacity of the containers.
Creativity and Imagination: The learner develops connection or networking skills when working out the volumes of frustums from cones and pyramids.
values:
Unity: the learner displays tolerance of different opinions while working with peers when models of frustums as a learning resource.
Respect: the learner listens to others’ opinions while discussing appropriate formulas for working out volume and capacity of containers.
pcis: Environment and technology: the learner uses appropriate containers from the local environment to work out the capacity of cones, pyramids, and their frustum.
